versions.changelog:
- Initial release of open-ended-goal-discovery skill.
- Enables agents to proactively discover and rank new, worthwhile goals based on capabilities, user signals, and preferences.
- Multi-dimensional scoring: value, novelty, feasibility, alignment; customizable weights.
- Produces actionable Top-N suggestions for the agent or user.
- Includes self-evolving learner module to adapt to user feedback and preferences over time.
- Fully standard library; ready for local execution and integration into long-horizon agent systems.
